title: Ferramenta.
subtitle: A family of Rust engines.
intro: Focused tools for text, code and documents. Choose the engine your work needs, with a shared standard of care and a contract of its own.

cards.ferroni: Oniguruma regular expressions and a multi-pattern scanner in Rust.
cards.ferriki: Highlight code with the grammars and themes your editor uses.
cards.ferromark: Turn Markdown into HTML, with CommonMark and GFM as the reference.
cards.ferrolex: Check prose and code with Hunspell dictionaries and deterministic suggestions.
cards.ferrocat: Read, merge and compile translation catalogs.
cards.ferralk: Match glob patterns and walk file trees in parallel.
cards.ferrugo: Render PDF previews under explicit resource limits.
